description: A subtype relationship between two anatomical terms: an assertion that one Anatomy term is a kind of (a subtype of) another, encoding the Uberon ontology's class hierarchy. The edge is directed from the more specific term (the child) to the more general term (the parent); a single anatomical term may have several parents. Both endpoints are Anatomy nodes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: The data sources that assert this edge. Always ["uberon"], since this relationship is sourced exclusively from Uberon.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: When this edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: `is_a` (subtype) relationships between non-obsolete anatomical terms in the Uberon basic anatomy ontology. An edge exists only where both the child and parent terms are present in SPOKE as Anatomy nodes; relationships pointing at an obsolete or absent term are not represented.
source_contributions.description: The anatomical subtype hierarchy from Uberon, a multi-species anatomy ontology. Each edge encodes one `is_a` assertion linking a subtype term to a more general term. The relationship carries no source-specific annotation beyond its existence.
